overall_notes: The paper focuses on evaluating code generation capabilities for software vulnerability repair. The extraction was largely accurate, but needed cleanup of model names (foundation models vs. agent models) and language specification. The paper uses execution-based evaluation through unit tests rather than traditional NLG metrics like BLEU/ROUGE.
